full_judgment:
Nazmun Ara Sultana J.: This Civil Petition The leave to appeal has. been directed against the judgment and order dated 05.01.2001 passed by the High Court Division the First Appeal No. 246 of 2008 allowing the appeal and setting aside the judgment and decree dated 22.05.2008 passed by the learned District Judge, Dhaka in Summary Suit No. 01 of 2007 decreeing the suit. 

 3. The present petitioner Yasmin Banu-a practicing, advocate of this court filed the above mentioned Summary Suit No. 01 of 2007 in the Court of the learned District Judge, Dhaka under Order 37 Rule 2 of the Code of Civil Procedure for realization of her legal fees for instituting Writ Petition No. 5594 of 2006 on behalf of the defendant as his engaged advocate. The suit was contested by the defendant and the learned district Judge decreed that suit to the tune of Tk. 1,50,000/- by the judgment and order dated 22.05.2008. 

 4. Being aggrieved by that judgment and order of the learned District Judge, Dhaka the defendant-respondent filed the aforementioned First Appeal No. 246 of 2008 before the High Court Division. A Division Bench of the High Court Division, after hearing both the parties, allowed that first appeal and set aside the judgment and decree passed by the learned District Judge holding that the claim of the plaintiff being disputed, did not fall within the ambit of Rule 2 of Order 37 of the Code of Procedure and as such the summary suit was not maintainable at all. 

 5. Being aggrieved by this judgment and decree of the High Court Division the plaintiff Yasmin Banu has filed this civil petition for cave to appeal.
